name: knowledge-base
description: Read-only retrieval from Markdown in an externally configured knowledge-base vault. Browse chapters, sections, and source-linked entries.

interface.shortDescription: Browse an externally configured read-only Markdown knowledge base.
interface.longDescription: Reads Markdown recursively below DOD_GUARD_KNOWLEDGE_BASE_DIR/entries and returns chapter, section, summary, and full-content views separately. The setting is required and the server exposes five read-only tools with no bundled corpus or write path.
defaultPrompt: Search the knowledge base and retrieve one selected entry.
